The '''Members of 6th [[Legislative Assembly of Jharkhand]]''' were elected in the [[2024 Jharkhand Legislative Assembly election]], with results announced on 23 November 2024.<ref>{{Cite web |title=General Election to Assembly Constituencies: Trends & Results November 2024 - Jharkhand |url=https://results.eci.gov.in/ResultAcGenNov2024/partywiseresult-S27.htm |website=results.eci.gov.in}}</ref><ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://www.prabhatkhabar.com/topic/jharkhand-assembly-election|title=झारखंड विधानसभा चुनाव परिणाम 2024, Jharkhand Vidhan Sabha Result, झारखंड विधानसभा चुनाव के नतीजे}}</ref>
